title: Finite energy subspace for time-periodic Schrödinger operators
summary: For $N$-body Schrö\-dinger operators with time-periodic short-range pair-potentials we show by a time-dependent commutator method that all channel wave operators exist. For $N=2$ we prove asymptotic completeness by a simplified version of the method, recovering Yajima's completeness result \cite{Yaj1} proven by a stationary method. We propose a definition of a \emph{finite energy subspace}, intuitively consisting of states with `finite asymptotic energy'.
